name: Arduino Nano (classic, mini-B USB)

outline.source: Arduino Nano (classic, mini-B USB) published dimensions (Arduino): 45 x 18 mm, treated as a rectangle

pcb.source: typical FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned on the drawing

mounting_holes.source: ASSUMED support points: the classic Arduino Nano has NO mounting holes; these two positions on the centre line between the header rows are suggested spots for printed support posts (M2 self-tapping), not holes in the board

connectors.name: mini-B USB
connectors.source: mini-B receptacle about 7.7 x 4.1 mm centred on the short edge (y = 9.0 mm), shell overhanging by about 1.2 mm
connectors.note: size and overhang approximate; clones differ

omitted: pin headers (2 x 15, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm apart; the pin tails protrude below the PCB)
reset button, ICSP header, ATmega328P and the USB-serial chip
